note: Cedar County NE zoning regulations (2000, rev. 2022) describe an Official Zoning Map on file, but no queryable zoning district service was found. County GIS is a gWorks web viewer (cedar.gworks.com) with no public ArcGIS REST endpoint found; the county services and planning pages link no zoning map or GIS service. Only parcel data from commercial vendors and an Iowa vendor org (Durant, IA zoning) turned up. Cities checked: Laurel NE's zoning map viewer is for Laurel, Mississippi; Hartington and Randolph publish zoning only as code text or PDF.
